selection: Production defaults from src/engine/poissonModel.cjs, previously chosen on the training window only.

metrics.definition: Hit rate is the share of matches where the most likely home/draw/away outcome happened. Brier is the average sum of squared errors across the three outcomes (lower is better, range 0 to 2). Log loss is the average negative log probability of the actual outcome (lower is better).

marketBlend: Not in these numbers. The historical files do not contain bookmaker odds. Live pages blend de-vigged SportyBet 1X2 prices when that feed answers.
information: Each prediction uses only earlier matches in the same league: season-to-date goals and the last eight results. Same-day matches are not used as inputs.
